subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `AgentTool.outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for model-visible result hints and runtime validation of `AgentToolResult.details`?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but adopting a new public plugin contract and its validation semantics is a durable product and compatibility decision that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the optional contract
options.body: Accept `outputSchema` as the canonical opt-in result contract and merge after the exact-head required gates complete.

options.title: Keep it internal for now
options.body: Limit result schemas to internal trusted tools until the external plugin API and upgrade guarantees are separately designed.

options.title: Pause the result-contract feature
options.body: Retain current unknown-output behavior and revisit the API when more plugin use cases establish the required contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional contract
recommendation.body: Accept `outputSchema` as the canonical opt-in result contract and merge after the exact-head required gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged Code Mode performance and catalog work makes this the strongest available feature-history owner, though final approval must come from a qualifying maintainer.
